question: Should CodexBar adopt this local-only Workspaces foundation, including the v11 cache rebuild and schema-5 SQLite sidecar, before reviewing the separate UI and preference behavior?
rationale: The branch is a deliberate staged feature boundary that permanently changes locally persisted CodexBar artifacts; source correctness and test proof cannot determine whether that product and long-term support commitment is desired.

options.title: Approve the staged foundation
options.body: Accept the documented local persistence and upgrade contract now, while keeping preference inheritance and UI behavior for the separate follow-up.

options.title: Request a narrower foundation
options.body: Keep the PR open but remove or defer persistence/analytics pieces until the desired public product boundary is agreed.

options.title: Defer Workspaces direction
options.body: Pause this foundation if CodexBar should not yet own a second persistent local-usage artifact.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the documented local persistence and upgrade contract now, while keeping preference inheritance and UI behavior for the separate follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership is the strongest available signal for accepting or deferring the new persistent-product boundary.
